property_summary: For any two distinct caller addresses A and B, if A successfully calls airDrop once on the correct contract, then B can still successfully call airDrop afterwards (so both balances increase by 20); the mutant that never resets the reentrancy lock can permanently block subsequent airDrop calls and so B's balance will not increase.
change_summary: Remove resetting of _locked to false after the function body so reentrancy lock stays true permanently, changing whether subsequent airDrop calls succeed.
